title: B-tzy
description: A game project published on GitHub, showcasing version control, structure and hands-on game development as a first flame.

title: Woolborn
description: A DnD-inspired text RPG set in Fårlandet. Choose your path, battle enemies and survive the shadow of the crater. A living, growing world.

title: Sheep Faction War
description: A lane-based real-time strategy game in HTML5 Canvas. Choose your faction, capture mid, destroy the enemy base. Built and balanced with care.

title: Fly från hagen
description: Play as a sheep with dreams of freedom. Gather wool, build courage and attempt to escape the pen. A cozy survival adventure in progress.
